description: This file defines the TechFilter activity class in an Android application, which handles NFC tag discovery events and updates the UI accordingly.

classes.name: TechFilter
classes.description: An Android Activity that detects NFC tags using the NFC adapter, and updates the text view with tag discovery information.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI, and handles the initial NFC intent to display a message.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles NFC tag discovery when a new intent is received, updating the UI.
